    The category algebra of a finite family of objects #

    Construction 2.8 and the proof of Proposition 2.10: "Put G = ⊕_{X ∈ ob C} X and Λ = End_{add C}(G)^{op}. For X in add C, the right Λ-modules R_X = C(G, X) are projective". For objects F x (x ∈ ι) of a k-linear category we realize Λ as ⊕_{x,y} C(F x, F y) with the product in path order ((a b)_{xz} = ∑_y a_{xy} ≫ b_{yz}: first a, then b). The paper's right Λ-modules are then left modules over this ring; R_X = (C(F y, X))_y with (a · m)_x = ∑_y a_{xy} ≫ m_y. The algebra A₀ of Construction 2.8 is the category algebra of the projective labels.
